displayIdentity.body: Jesus prepares disciples for hatred and persecution, recalls servant and master, identifies ignorance of the sender, and promises the Counselor’s testimony alongside the disciples’ witness from the beginning.
displayIdentity.title: World hatred is held beside Counselor and witness
